topic.name: PIK3CA
topic.short_description: Oncogene frequently mutated in breast cancer
topic.seo_title: PIK3CA Gene Mutations in Cancer Research - Latest Studies & Findings | Your Cancer Breakthroughs
topic.seo_description: Explore PIK3CA mutations in cancer research. Learn how this frequently mutated oncogene is studied in breast cancer diagnostics and precision medicine treatments.
topic.seo_intro:
PIK3CA is an oncogene that encodes a protein involved in cell growth and survival pathways. Mutations in this gene are among the most frequently detected alterations in breast cancer and several other cancer types, making it a critical focus for cancer researchers and precision medicine development. Understanding PIK3CA mutations helps scientists identify which patients may benefit from targeted therapies and improved diagnostic approaches.

The study of PIK3CA in cancer research has accelerated significantly in recent years as advanced sequencing technologies have revealed the prevalence and diversity of these mutations across patient populations. Researchers are investigating how PIK3CA mutations drive cancer development, how they affect treatment response, and how they can be leveraged for developing new therapeutic strategies. This biomarker holds promise for improving patient stratification and enabling more personalized treatment decisions in oncology.

On this page, you'll find the latest peer-reviewed research articles, clinical insights, and scientific breakthroughs related to PIK3CA mutations and cancer. These resources represent current findings from the global cancer research community and are designed to help patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals stay informed about this important area of cancer biology and diagnostics.

articles.title: A Modular Open Label, Signal Seeking, Phase II Trial of Targeted Therapies for Patients With Slow-Flow or Fast-Flow Vascular Malformations (TARGET-VM)
articles.hook: Alpelisib and mirdametinib target PIK3CA and MAPK mutations in vascular malformations
articles.summary: Study tests targeted cancer drugs (alpelisib and mirdametinib) to treat vascular malformations caused by specific genetic mutations.

articles.title: Phase I Trial Of Alpelisib Plus Sacituzumab Govitecan In Patients With Metastatic Or Locally Recurrent HER2-Negative Breast Cancer
articles.hook: Alpelisib plus sacituzumab govitecan shows tolerability in HER2-negative breast cancer
articles.summary: Researchers tested combining two drugs, alpelisib and sacituzumab govitecan, to treat advanced HER2-negative breast cancer.

articles.title: Trp53 loss drives the neoplastic transformation of Pik3caH1047R-induced vascular malformation in a mouse model.
articles.hook: P53 loss transforms PIK3CA-mutant vascular malformations into angiosarcoma**
articles.summary: PIK3CA mutation causes vascular malformations in mice, while additional p53 loss promotes rare transformation to angiosarcoma.

articles.title: Targeting FGFR signaling overcomes therapeutic resistance and immune evasion in oncogenic PIK3CA-driven serous-like endometrial cancer.
articles.hook: FGFR and PI3K inhibitor combination overcomes resistance in endometrial cancer
articles.summary: Combining FGFR and PI3K inhibitors overcomes drug resistance in aggressive serous endometrial cancer by restoring immune responses.

articles.title: [Clinicopathological characteristics of lung adenocarcinoma with PIK3CA mutation].
articles.hook: PIK3CA mutations define lung adenocarcinoma subtype without prognostic impact
articles.summary: Lung adenocarcinoma patients with PIK3CA mutations show distinct characteristics, but these mutations don't significantly impact prognosis or drive drug resistance.

articles.title: Health-Related Quality of Life and Symptom Severity Among Patients With PIK3CA-Related Overgrowth Spectrum: A Mixed-Methods Study to Understand Real-World Experience With Alpelisib Treatment.
articles.hook: Alpelisib improves quality of life in PIK3CA-related overgrowth patients
articles.summary: Alpelisib treatment improves quality of life and reduces symptoms in patients with rare PIK3CA-related overgrowth disorders.

articles.title: Expert recommendations for PIK3CA testing in HR+/HER2- locally advanced and metastatic breast cancer.
articles.hook: PIK3CA testing improves treatment selection in HR+/HER2- breast cancer
articles.summary: Experts recommend early PIK3CA testing in HR+/HER2- breast cancer to guide targeted therapy selection and improve treatment outcomes.

articles.title: Assessment of alpelisib-induced hyperglycemia in a real-world setting: A nationwide claims data analysis.
articles.hook: Alpelisib-induced hyperglycemia management improves breast cancer treatment adherence
articles.summary: Breast cancer patients on alpelisib who received blood sugar medication stayed on treatment longer, highlighting the need for proactive glucose monitoring.

articles.title: Safety analyses of the INAVO120 randomised phase III trial of inavolisib or placebo with palbociclib-fulvestrant in patients with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, endocrine-resistant advanced breast cancer.
articles.hook: Inavolisib plus palbociclib-fulvestrant improves survival in PIK3CA-mutated breast cancer
articles.summary: Inavolisib combined with standard breast cancer drugs improved survival in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer with PIK3CA mutations, with manageable side effects.

articles.title: (Phospho)proteomic Profiling Reveals Mutation-Specific Adaptive Signaling to PI3Kα Inhibition in PIK3CA Mutant Breast Epithelial Cells.
articles.hook: PI3K and MAPK dual inhibition suppresses PIK3CA mutant breast cancer
articles.summary: Combined PI3K and MAPK inhibition more effectively suppresses growth than single-agent therapy in PIK3CA mutant breast cancer cells.
